title: AI-Assisted Quantum & Classical Oracle Separation of QMA(2) ≠ QMA and No-Disentanglers Theorem
whyItMatters: Quantum complexity theorists disclosed GPT-5.6 Sol generated the key proof idea separating QMA(2) from QMA via a quantum oracle and proving Watrous’s No-Disentanglers Conjecture—soon strengthened to a classical oracle via GPT-6 Astra.
summary: In two back-to-back landmark quantum complexity preprints, researchers explicitly credited OpenAI reasoning models with generating the central proof constructions. On September 2, 2026 (arXiv:2609.02865; Simons Institute lecture Oct 1), John Bostanci, Sabee Grewal, Jonas Haferkamp, and collaborators constructed a quantum oracle separating QMA(2) (two unentangled quantum proofs) from QMA and proved Watrous’s unrelativized geometric No-Disentanglers Conjecture (showing any approximate disentangler needs exponentially many input qubits)—explicitly disclosing that ChatGPT 5.6 Sol proposed the "miraculous" symmetric/antisymmetric subspace projector construction combining She–Yuen’s unitary polynomial method. On October 5, 2026 (arXiv:2610.06760), Grewal, Mutreja, and Tomer strengthened this to a classical oracle separation (QMA^A ≠ QMA(2)^A), disclosing the original proof came from ~10 rounds with ChatGPT 6 Astra before human verification and rewriting.
technicalHighlights: Resolves Watrous’s unrelativized geometric No-Disentanglers Conjecture at constant error ε + δ < 1 and separates QMA(2) from QMA relative to a quantum oracle (arXiv:2609.02865).
Strengthened one month later to a classical oracle separation QMA^A ≠ QMA(2)^A via a signed-graph separable-Hamiltonian problem (arXiv:2610.06760).
Authors published transparent AI tool disclosures noting GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra generated the core proof ideas, which human quantum theorists fully checked and rewrote.
caveats: Class separations are relativized (quantum and classical oracles) rather than an unrelativized proof of QMA(2) ≠ QMA; preprints are under active review.

scoreRationale.foundational: Settles the long-standing Watrous No-Disentanglers Conjecture (unrelativized) and achieves both quantum and classical oracle separations of QMA(2) vs QMA.
scoreRationale.ripple: Set the gold standard for transparent AI-assistance disclosure in theoretical computer science and quantum complexity papers.
scoreRationale.verification: Human quantum-complexity leaders checked, reorganized, and presented the proofs (including at the Simons Institute), though formal journal peer review is pending.
scoreRationale.velocity: Core constructions emerged in roughly 10 rounds of prompting and moved from quantum to classical oracle separation in 33 days.
